rules.name: rrr-fx-rates-probe-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT p.invenio_product_code, p.currency FROM opera.product_master_table p WHERE p.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1) AND upper(p.invenio_product_code) LIKE 'CR %'
SELECT m.currency, m.spot, m.quantotype FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table m WHERE m.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1)

SELECT u.underlying_id, u.settlement_date, u.value_date, u.settle_value::text AS settle_value FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1) AND u.settlement_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-10-01' AND lower(trim(u.underlying_id)) IN ( SELECT lower(trim(m.spot)) FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table m WHERE m.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = 'CFS' LIMIT 1))
